module: Flowgraph node 'Lights Controller' (repeat_instant category) for the drag race starting light (speed-based version). Same sequence as Countdown Lights Controller (Pro or classic tree), but the false start is detected with the 'velocity' pin > 0.5. Outputs: flow, disqualified, started.
notes: self.lights is only created by the 'reset' impulse: without a prior reset, work raises an error.
flow is always true on output.
The node's description is identical to that of the other drag race light nodes.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

initLights.desc: Searches the scene for the stage and countdown lights.

_executionStarted.desc: Resets the state and the outputs to zero.

work.desc: On reset: resets the state and hides the lights. Otherwise advances the timer, handles the ambers/green, sets started=true, detects the false start (velocity > 0.5): disqualified=true, ambers and right red on.
